battle.name: 第一次國共內戰
battle.brief: 第一次國共內戰自1927年4月的上海清黨事件後展開，國民革命軍與共產黨武裝在華中、華南及江西等地逐步對抗。當時軍隊仍沿用近代砲兵裝備，1870年列裝的德製Breech-loading cannon屬後膛火砲，可用於野戰火力支援。

kit.name: 婆塞德後膛砲
kit.history: Breech-loading cannon是德國陸軍近代化砲兵體系中的後膛火砲，1870年列裝，配置於野戰砲兵單位，負責以曲射火力支援地面作戰。

countries: 本篇把「第一次國共內戰」界定為1927年國共合作在軍事上中斷，至1937年七七事變爆發、第二次國共合作形成以前的第一階段。主要交戰者是南京國民政府所轄國民革命軍及其協作省軍，和中國共產黨領導的紅軍、地方武裝及蘇維埃區。1927年的武漢國民政府一度與南京對抗，隨後以「寧漢合流」重組政治局面，但在此之前，武漢方面已奉命解除共產黨籍武裝，故紅軍同時面對南京與武漢兩套命令。雲南、廣西等地方軍並非全程站在同一邊，常隨省界、駐軍地域與中央命令轉向，不能把國民革命軍各部視為始終一致的戰力。蘇聯提供武器、顧問與軍事技術，但並非這一階段的交戰國；日本在1937年造成全面抗戰的外部轉折，也不屬於此前十年的內戰交戰方。戰線因此遍及江西、湖南、湖北、廣東、福建與陝北，而真正決定戰局的是鐵路、渡口、山口、糧彈基地及可供師級部隊運動的道路。
countriesEn: This account defines the First Chinese Civil War as the first phase between the military rupture of the KMT–CCP partnership in 1927 and the full-scale outbreak of resistance against Japan in July 1937, immediately before the Second United Front was completed. The principal belligerents were the National Revolutionary Army and allied provincial forces under the Nanjing National Government on one side, and the Red Army, local armed organizations, and Soviet areas led by the Chinese Communist Party on the other. The Wuhan National Government initially opposed Nanjing but later took part in the Nanjing–Wuhan reconciliation. Before that reconciliation, however, Wuhan had ordered the disarmament of Communist-led formations, so the Red Army faced rival commands from both Nanjing and Wuhan. Forces from Yunnan, Guangxi, and other provinces did not remain consistently aligned with either side; their conduct shifted with provincial boundaries, troop locations, and orders from the central government. The Soviet Union supplied weapons, advisers, and technical assistance without becoming a belligerent in this phase. Japan supplied the external shock that transformed the conflict in 1937, but it was not a party to the preceding civil war. The fighting therefore extended across Jiangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Guangdong, Fujian, and northern Shaanxi, while control of railways, river crossings, mountain passes, supply depots, and roads capable of moving division-sized formations decided the outcome.
people: 蔣中正是南京方面的核心指揮者，他以中央軍、黨政命令和軍事經費逐步壓縮共產黨的武裝空間；李宗仁、何香凝等則在武漢政府中掌握軍政，李宗仁主持的武漢軍方曾要求第十一師、第二十師等共產黨籍部隊繳械。南昌起義時，周恩來主持政治工作，朱德任參謀長，葉挺以第十一師師長身分指揮，賀龍掌握第二十軍，劉伯承擔任參謀長，四人的分工使起義部隊得以在1927年8月1日同時奪取城內關鍵位置。毛澤東在秋收起義中率工農革命軍第一軍第一師活動，劉志丹、謝子長則在陝北建立地方革命武裝；朱德、陳毅於1928年率湘南部隊抵達井岡山，與毛澤東會合，使井岡山部隊由一支地方軍隊擴展為跨省行動的紅軍骨幹。廣州起義由張太雷、蘇兆徵、葉挺等指揮，葉挺再次擔任軍事指揮者，張太雷則在起義失敗前遇難。1936年西安事變中，張學良、楊虎城扣留蔣中正，周恩來赴西安協商停火，紅軍三大主力會師後形成的軍事格局，也由此轉入八路軍編制。
peopleEn: Chiang Kai-shek was the central commander on the Nanjing side, using the Central Army, party-government authority, and military finance to steadily reduce the space available to Communist armed organizations. Li Jishen and He Xiangning were prominent in the Wuhan government, where Li directed a military command that required Communist-led formations such as the Eleventh and Twentieth Divisions to disarm. At the Nanchang Uprising, Zhou Enlai handled political work, Zhu De served as chief of staff, Ye Ting commanded as commander of the Eleventh Division, He Long controlled the Twentieth Army, and Liu Bocheng again served as chief of staff. Their division of responsibilities allowed the insurgents to seize several key positions in the city simultaneously on 1 August 1927. Mao Zedong led the First Division of the Workers’ and Peasants’ Revolutionary Army during the Autumn Harvest Uprising, while Liu Zhidan and Xie Zichang developed local revolutionary forces in northern Shaanxi. In 1928, Zhu De and Chen Yi brought troops from southern Hunan to Jinggangshan and joined Mao, turning a regional force into the core of a Red Army capable of operating across provincial boundaries. The Guangzhou Uprising was directed by Zhang Tailei, Su Zhaozheng, and Ye Ting; Ye Ting again assumed military command, and Zhang Tailei was killed before the uprising collapsed. During the Xi’an Incident of 1936, Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek, and Zhou Enlai went to Xi’an to negotiate a ceasefire. The reorganization that followed the convergence of the Red Army’s three main fronts also prepared the formation of the Eighth Route Army.
kits: 1920年代國民革命軍步兵師的標準表定編制約九千人，通常包括步兵團、炮兵團、工兵、騎兵、運輸、通信及衛生分隊；步兵營仍是主要火力單位，部分師在1930年前後增設第三個步兵團。步槍以漢陽造八十八式步槍為基礎，口徑7.92×57毫米，另有日製三八式步槍，使用6.5×50毫米R彈；兩種步槍也分別配用同口徑輕機槍，不能把步槍與機槍彈藥混作一談。軍官常配毛瑟C96手槍或勃朗寧M1900手槍，重機槍則有 Maxim M1910水冷式及 Schwarzlose M07/12等歐洲型號。炮兵配備中國仿製的八十八式75毫米野戰炮，部分部隊也使用日製二十四式75毫米山炮。紅軍步槍主要是莫辛－那甘1891/30型，使用7.62×54毫米R彈，另以納干特M1895左輪手槍補充近戰射擊；從國民革命軍手中繳獲的八十八式步槍與Maxim M1910機槍，又使紅軍同時接觸7.92毫米與7.62毫米兩組子彈。國民革命軍以連、營為核心，依賴鐵路、公路、汽車、馬匹和輜重車維持供應；紅軍更多使用騾馬、挑夫式人力的背運與繳獲物資。彈藥由彈匣、彈帶、木箱及炮彈箱分裝，缺彈時任何一級指揮官都無法用射擊訓練彌補 caliber、槍管與瞄準具的差異。
kitsEn: A standard National Revolutionary Army infantry division in the 1920s had a paper strength of about 9,000 men and normally comprised infantry regiments, an artillery regiment, engineers, cavalry, transport, signals, and medical elements. Infantry battalions remained the principal fighting units, and some divisions added a third infantry regiment around 1930. The basic rifle was the Chinese Type 88, derived from the Hanyang rifle and chambered in 7.92×57 mm; the Japanese Type 38 rifle in 6.5×50 mm R was also issued. Light machine guns normally used the ammunition matching their own caliber rather than a single universal belt, and officers commonly carried the Mauser C96 or Browning M1900 pistol. Heavy machine guns included the water-cooled Maxim M1910 and European types such as the Schwarzlose M07/12. NRA artillery used Chinese-built Type 88 75 mm field guns, while some formations also received Japanese Type 24 75 mm mountain guns. Red Army infantry primarily carried the Mosin–Nagant 1891/30 rifle in 7.62×54 mm R and used the Nagant M1895 revolver for close-range defense. Captured NRA Type 88 rifles and Maxim M1910 machine guns exposed Red Army units to both 7.92 mm and 7.62 mm ammunition systems. NRA supply rested on railways, roads, motor vehicles, horses, and wagon trains, whereas Red Army columns relied more heavily on mules, pack transport, and captured stocks. Ammunition moved in magazines, belts, wooden cases, and artillery ammunition boxes; when supplies ran short, no amount of marksmanship training could compensate for differences in cartridge, rifle, or sight configuration.
tactics: 1927年的行動首先以城市奪點展開。南昌起義部隊在8月1日凌晨攻入城區，試圖控制火車站、機關、電報與軍械，同時把部隊推往江西南部，企圖與廣東方面的地方武裝會合；南京與武漢方面則利用鐵路、汽車和電報線迅速調兵，封住城郊道路與渡口，使起義軍雖一度奪城，卻無法長期保持省級中心的補給。秋收起義由文家市出發後轉向長沙，攻城未能成功，隊伍轉入湘贛山區，最後在井岡山建立第一個穩定的 rural base。廣州起義在12月11日控制若干城區、鐵路和軍械點，但守軍由外圍反擊，起義軍至12月13日已無法維持完整指揮，至此，三次城市起義都未能把軍隊帶出國民革命軍控制的交通線。1928年至1930年的井岡山戰役，國民革命軍採取固定封鎖與分批推進：先以師級部隊封住通往山區的主要道路，再用炮兵和步兵沿狹窄通道攻擊，企圖迫使紅軍在彈藥不足的情況下決戰。紅軍則避免固守城鎮，利用夜行軍、山林遮蔽、側翼集中與局部優勢攻擊封線薄弱處，離開包圍圈後再轉移。1930年後，紅軍在贛南、閩西建立較大的根據地，1931年11月在瑞金成立中華蘇維埃共和國臨時中央政府，使原先的游擊隊能以師、旅作戰。國民革命軍在1933年至1934年改用重點進攻與交通線封鎖，奪取中央蘇區多處城鎮，迫使紅軍實行總撤退。1934年10月，中央紅軍主力從贛南于都一帶突破封鎖，經湘、桂、黔、滇、川進入長江上游，在赤水河反覆四次轉向，於5月渡金沙江、6月強渡大渡河，再翻雪山、走草地，最終在1935年10月抵達陝北吳起鎮。1935至1936年，紅軍在陝北以游擊與運動戰保存力量，國民革命軍則集中部隊反覆進攻；西安事變後，前線停火，1937年9月紅軍主力正式改編為八路軍第一一五、第一二〇、第一二九師，第一階段的正面內戰至此轉為對日作戰。
tacticsEn: Operations in 1927 began with seizures of urban positions. The Nanchang insurgents entered the city in the early hours of 1 August and sought control of the railway station, government offices, telegraph system, and arms depots, while pushing troops south through Jiangxi in an attempt to link with local armed forces in Guangdong. Nanjing and Wuhan then used railways, motor vehicles, and telegraph lines to concentrate troops and close roads and ferry crossings outside the city. The insurgents had taken Nanchang, but could not keep a provincial center supplied. The Autumn Harvest force left Wenmei, turned toward Changsha, failed to take the city, moved into the Hunan–Jiangxi mountains, and established its first durable rural base at Jinggangshan. The Guangzhou insurgents occupied several city districts, railway facilities, and arms stores on 11 December, but counterattacks from the perimeter broke their control by 13 December. All three urban risings therefore failed to carry their troops beyond the transport network controlled by the NRA. During the Jinggangshan fighting of 1928–1930, NRA forces used blockade lines and advances in stages: divisions first sealed the main roads into the mountains, then artillery and infantry advanced along narrow approaches to force the Red Army into battle while short of ammunition. The Red Army avoided permanent town defense, using night movement, wooded terrain, concentration against one flank, and attacks on weak points in the blockade before withdrawing and shifting position. After establishing a larger base in southern Jiangxi and western Fujian in 1930, it could conduct operations with divisions and brigades. The provisional government of the Chinese Soviet Republic was established at Ruijin in November 1931. From 1933 to 1934, NRA commanders shifted to priority attacks and transport-line control, taking several Central Soviet towns and compelling the Red Army’s strategic withdrawal. In October 1934, the Central Red Army broke out from the Yud u area of southern Jiangxi, passed through Hunan, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, and Sichuan, made four turns across the Chishui River, crossed the Jinsha in May and the Dadu in June 1935, traversed the snow mountains and grasslands, and reached Wuqi in northern Shaanxi that October. During 1935–1936, the Red Army used mobile and guerrilla operations to preserve its strength in northern Shaanxi while NRA forces mounted repeated campaigns. The ceasefire following the Xi’an Incident ended the main field confrontation, and in September 1937 the former Red Army formations became the 115th, 120th, and 129th Divisions of the Eighth Route Army as the first phase gave way to war against Japan.
data: 可核對的時間線始於1927年4月12日蔣中正在南京掌握中央軍並解除共產黨武裝，此後合作轉為軍事對抗。7月武漢政府清共，8月1日南昌起義，8月7日中共在漢口召開緊急會議並決定武裝反抗；9月11日毛澤東在文家市發動秋收起義，9月21日攻長沙失利，10月起向井岡山轉進；12月11日廣州起義，至12月13日失敗。1928年4月朱德、陳毅部與毛澤東部會合，4月至5月國民革命軍對井岡山發動第一次圍剿；其後數次圍剿迫使紅軍轉戰贛南、閩西。1930年中央根據地擴展，1931年11月中華蘇維埃共和國臨時中央政府在瑞金成立。1933年至1934年的重點圍剿使中央蘇區大幅縮小，10月中央紅軍主力突破于都封鎖。1935年1月至3月四渡赤水，5月渡金沙江，6月強渡大渡河，8月至10月穿越雪山草地，10月三大主力在陝北會師。1936年12月12日西安事變爆發，12月和平解決並形成停止內戰的安排；1937年8月25日中共中央軍委發布改編命令，9月16日八路軍番號及三師番號正式公布。國民革命軍的炮彈由前線兵站、汽車隊和鐵路側送，紅軍的長途彈藥則依靠馬匹、挑夫、繳獲倉庫和地方游擊隊轉運。歷次戰鬥的完整傷亡名冊多已散失，本篇因此不列無法核實的精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology begins on 12 April 1927, when Chiang Kai-shek took control of the Central Army in Nanjing and moved against Communist armed organizations, transforming the former partnership into a military confrontation. The Wuhan government moved against the Communists in July. The Nanchang Uprising began on 1 August, and the CCP emergency conference at Hankou met on 7 August to decide on armed resistance. Mao Zedong launched the Autumn Harvest Uprising at Wenmei on 11 September; the attack on Changsha failed on 21 September, and the force began moving toward Jinggangshan in October. The Guangzhou Uprising began on 11 December and collapsed by 13 December. Zhu De and Chen Yi joined Mao at Jinggangshan in April 1928, and the NRA’s First Encirclement Campaign against the base ran from April to May. Later campaigns drove the Red Army into southern Jiangxi and western Fujian. The central base area expanded in 1930, and the provisional government of the Chinese Soviet Republic was established at Ruijin in November 1931. Priority campaigns in 1933–1934 sharply reduced the Central Soviet area, forcing the main Red Army to break out from the Yud u blockade in October. The First Front Army crossed the Chishui four times between January and March 1935, the Jinsha in May, and the Dadu in June, then crossed the snow mountains and grasslands from August to October before the three main forces converged in northern Shaanxi. The Xi’an Incident began on 12 December 1936 and was resolved that month with arrangements to stop the civil war. The CCP Central Military Commission issued the reorganization order on 25 August 1937, and the Eighth Route Army designation and the three division numbers were formally published on 16 September. NRA artillery ammunition moved through forward depots, motor columns, and railway deliveries; the Red Army’s long-range supply depended on horses, porters, captured depots, and guerrilla couriers. Complete casualty registers for most of these battles have not survived, so this account gives no unverifiable precise casualty figures.
cause: 戰爭不是由單一事件突然造成，而是1924至1927年合作中的權力矛盾逐步轉化。國民革命軍需要在北伐後取得統一全國的軍權、政權與財政權，共產黨則維持自己的政治組織、農民運動方案及獨立武力；蘇聯顧問和共產國際的影響，使蘇維埃與國民革命軍的指揮關係始終帶有外部色彩。1927年春，南京方面的軍事與黨政清洗先後消除共產黨在城市內的公開職位，武漢方面隨後也要求共產黨籍部隊繳械，國民革命軍第廿師、第十一師等若接受命令，其軍事身分便會消失，拒絕則直接構成抗命。寧漢分裂又使中央命令互相牴觸，地方軍隊可因駐地而選擇南京或武漢，削弱任何一方迅速集結全部力量的能力。共產黨當時準備的是以中心城市為支點的武裝起義，但紅軍缺少足以守住城市、持續供應炮彈和封鎖港口的工業與重炮能力；相對而言，國民革命軍掌握鐵路、造船、軍工與師級重火力，優勢明顯。戰局轉變於南昌、秋收與廣州接連受挫之後：紅軍放棄守住大城市的企圖，轉向交通不便而便於保存指揮核心的邊區，國民革命軍則以重兵圍剿取代零散清剿，長期對抗遂由此形成。
causeEn: The war did not begin with a single isolated event; it developed from contradictions within the alliance of 1924–1927. The National Revolutionary Army needed military, political, and fiscal authority after completing the Northern Expedition, while the Communist Party maintained its own political organization, agrarian program, and independent armed forces. Soviet advisers and the influence of the Comintern gave the relationship between the Soviet movement and the NRA an external character from the beginning. In the spring of 1927, Nanjing’s military and party purge removed the Communists’ public positions in the cities, and Wuhan then required Communist-led units to surrender their arms. Formations such as the NRA Twentieth and Eleventh Divisions would lose their military identity if they obeyed; refusal would amount directly to mutiny. The Nanjing–Wuhan split produced contradictory central orders, and provincial troops could choose one capital or the other according to their locations, preventing either side from quickly concentrating all available forces. The Communist plan was then based on armed uprisings in major cities, but the Red Army lacked the industrial capacity, heavy artillery, ammunition reserves, and port control needed to hold those cities. The NRA, by contrast, controlled railways, shipping, arsenals, and division-scale firepower. The sequence of defeats at Nanchang, the Autumn Harvest operation, and Guangzhou changed the pattern. The Red Army stopped trying to retain large cities and moved into peripheral regions where roads were difficult and a command core could be preserved, while the NRA replaced scattered punitive actions with concentrated encirclement campaigns, creating the prolonged conflict that followed.
impact: 對國民革命軍而言，1927年三次起義雖在南昌、長沙與廣州等城市得手，卻暴露出一個嚴重問題：占領車站和機關不等於控制交通，若鐵路與渡口不能長期保持，城市會迅速被援軍切斷。此後的圍剿作戰因此更重視封鎖線、兵站、炮兵集中與連續推進，作戰由革命軍內部少數武裝對抗，轉為中央軍、保安團及省軍對區域紅軍的系統戰術。對中共而言，失去中心城市並非毫無結果，紅軍保留了完整的師級指揮、並在井岡山、贛南、閩西和中央蘇區建立軍事與行政機構，使武裝鬥爭能在國民革命軍控制的交通線之外持續。中央蘇區在1934年被大幅壓縮，但主力透過長征轉移到陝北；中共中央在轉移途中確立毛澤東的軍事領導地位，三大主力會師後又以游擊和運動戰抵禦陝北圍剿，生存條件由南方的稻米、鹽與礦產區轉向較貧瘠但更易防守的陝北高原。1936年西安事變則改變戰爭的制度條件：紅軍主力不是被消滅，而是以八路軍番號納入對日作戰體系；國民革命軍也由單一黨內軍事清算轉向維持中央政權、對外抗日與有限度聯共並行的局面。
impactEn: For the NRA, the victories at Nanchang, the failed operations around Changsha, and the temporary seizure of Guangzhou exposed a serious problem: taking a railway station or government office did not amount to controlling transport, and a city could be cut off quickly unless its railways and crossings remained secure. Later encirclement operations consequently placed greater emphasis on blockade lines, depots, concentrated artillery, and continuous advances, turning a struggle by a few armed formations within the revolutionary army into a systematic campaign by the Central Army, security forces, and provincial troops against regional Red Armies. For the CCP, losing the major cities was not without result. The Red Army retained intact divisional command structures and created military and administrative institutions at Jinggangshan, in southern Jiangxi and western Fujian, and in the Central Soviet area, allowing armed struggle to continue outside NRA transport corridors. Although the Central Soviet area was heavily compressed in 1934, its main force survived through the Long March and shifted to northern Shaanxi. During that transfer, Mao Zedong’s military leadership became established within the CCP. After the three main forces converged, guerrilla and mobile operations helped the Red Army withstand campaigns in northern Shaanxi. The geographic basis of operations changed from the rice, salt, and mining districts of southern China to the poorer but more defensible Loess Plateau. The Xi’an Incident of 1936 altered the institutional conditions of the war. The Red Army was not destroyed; its principal formations entered the national war effort against Japan under the Eighth Route Army designation. The NRA likewise moved from a single-party military purge toward a combination of central political control, resistance against Japan, and limited cooperation with the Communists.
result: 到1937年9月，第一次國共內戰第一階段並沒有出現一方徹底消滅另一方的結果。若按主要戰役判斷，1927年的南昌、秋收與廣州行動都未能奪取可長期防守的省級中心，國民革命軍在開局占據主動；井岡山、中央蘇區及其他早期蘇區雖然先後被國民革命軍以集中兵力攻取，紅軍主力卻未被消滅，而是在轉移中保存下來並於1935年在陝北會師。到抗戰爆發時，南京政府仍控制主要城市、鐵路與中央行政系統，中共則保有陝北基地、相當完整的軍事組織，以及由紅軍主力改編而成的八路軍三個師。西安事變後的停火安排與九月的合作命令，使全面內戰暫時轉為共同抗日，內戰的暫時終止因而帶有談判和體制重組的性質，不是戰場上的單一勝負。歷次戰役因檔案殘缺而沒有可信的總傷亡數字，任何把起義、圍剿及長征傷亡相加後宣稱精確總數的做法，都無法由現存資料支持。這一階段的直接軍事結果，是國民革命軍保住中央政權與大部分正規軍，紅軍避開封鎖、保存主力並轉向西北；政治結果則是共產黨取得公開的合法軍事位置，國民黨仍握中央政權，兩者都沒有獲得決定全國局勢的最終勝利。
resultEn: By September 1937, the first phase of the Chinese Civil War had not ended with the complete destruction of either side. Judged campaign by campaign, the Nanchang, Autumn Harvest, and Guangzhou operations of 1927 failed to secure provincial centers that could be defended for long, leaving the NRA in the stronger position at the beginning. Jinggangshan, the Central Soviet area, and several earlier Soviet bases were subsequently taken by concentrated NRA operations, but the main Red Army was not annihilated. It survived the strategic transfer, consolidated in northern Shaanxi in 1935, and remained organized when full-scale resistance against Japan began. At that point, the Nanjing government still controlled the principal cities, railway network, and central administration. The CCP retained a base in northern Shaanxi, a substantial military organization, and the three divisions formed from the former Red Army. The ceasefire arrangements following the Xi’an Incident and the cooperation orders issued in September converted an unrestricted civil war into a common front against Japan. The temporary end of the civil war therefore arose from negotiation and institutional reorganization rather than a single battlefield decision. Because records are incomplete, no reliable total casualty figure exists for the uprisings, encirclement campaigns, and Long March; any claim that sums these into a precise total exceeds what the surviving evidence can support. The direct military result was that the NRA preserved the central government and most of its regular army, while the Red Army evaded encirclement, preserved its main force, and moved to the northwest. The political result was that the CCP obtained a recognized legal military position while the KMT retained central state power. Neither side achieved a final victory capable of deciding the national situation.
